function.name: GdipCloneBrush
function.description: This function clones a brush object. It handles different types of brushes such as solid color, hatch fill, path gradient, linear gradient, and texture fill. The function also handles memory allocation and error checking for these operations.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to the brush object to be cloned.

parameters.name: clone
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, which will point to the cloned brush object after the function execution.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are null, 'OutOfMemory' if there is not enough memory to complete the operation, and 'NotImplemented' if the brush type is not supported.

function.name: get_hatch_data
function.description: This function retrieves hatch data based on the provided hatch style. If the hatch style is within the range of the HatchBrushes array, it assigns the corresponding HatchBrushes element to the result pointer and returns 'Ok'. If the hatch style is out of range, it returns 'NotImplemented'.

parameters.name: hatchstyle
parameters.description: This parameter represents the style of the hatch for which data is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer. The function assigns the address of the corresponding HatchBrushes element to this pointer.

function.return_type: GpStatus. This represents the status of the function execution. It returns 'Ok' if the hatch style is within the range of the HatchBrushes array, otherwise it returns 'NotImplemented'.

function.name: GdipCreateHatchBrush
function.description: This function creates a hatch brush with specified style, foreground color, and background color. It allocates memory for the brush and sets its properties.

parameters.name: hatchstyle
parameters.description: This parameter defines the style of the hatch brush.

parameters.name: forecol
parameters.description: This parameter defines the foreground color of the hatch brush.

parameters.name: backcol
parameters.description: This parameter defines the background color of the hatch brush.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a GpHatch structure. The function allocates memory for this structure and the pointer is used to return it.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are not valid, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails, or 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: create_line_brush

parameters.name: startcolor
parameters.description: Specifies the starting color of the gradient

parameters.name: endcolor
parameters.description: Specifies the ending color of the gradient

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: Specifies the wrap mode for the gradient

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a GpLineGradient structure. This structure will be allocated and filled within the function.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the function execution. It returns 'Ok' if the function executes successfully, and 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails.

function.name: linegradient_init_transform
function.description: This function initializes the transformation for a line gradient. It calculates the translation, rotation, and scaling factors based on the start and end points of the gradient and the properties of the line gradient object.

parameters.name: startpoint
parameters.description: This is the starting point of the line gradient.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: This is the ending point of the line gradient.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: This is the line gradient object to be transformed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the line gradient object passed as a parameter.

function.name: GdipCreateLineBrush
function.description: This function creates a line brush with a gradient. The gradient is defined by start and end points, and start and end colors. The wrap mode and line gradient are also parameters.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: The ending point of the gradient.

parameters.name: startcolor
parameters.description: The color at the start of the gradient.

parameters.name: endcolor
parameters.description: The color at the end of the gradient.

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: The wrap mode of the gradient.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: The line gradient to be created.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns 'Ok'. If not, it returns an error status.

function.name: create_path_gradient
function.description: This function creates a path gradient. It calculates the center of the path and sets the gradient's properties accordingly. It also allocates memory for the gradient and its properties, and frees the memory if any allocation fails.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Pointer to the path for which the gradient is to be created.

parameters.name: centercolor
parameters.description: The color at the center of the gradient.

parameters.name: grad
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a GpPathGradient object. This function will allocate memory for the GpPathGradient object and update the pointer to point to it.

function.return_type: GpStatus. Returns 'Ok' if the function successfully creates the gradient. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if either 'path' or 'grad' is NULL. Returns 'OutOfMemory' if there are fewer than 2 points in the path, or if memory allocation for the gradient or its properties fails.

function.name: GdipCreatePathGradient
function.description: This function creates a path gradient and assigns it to the 'grad' parameter. It first checks if the 'grad' parameter is null or if the 'points' parameter is null or if 'count' is less than or equal to 0. If any of these conditions are met, it returns an error status. Otherwise, it creates a path, adds a line to the path using the points provided, and then creates a path gradient. If any of these operations fail, it cleans up and returns the error status. If all operations succeed, it sets the wrap mode of the gradient and returns the status.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of points that define the boundary of the path gradient.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of points in the array.

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: Specifies how to tile the gradient outside the path.

parameters.name: grad
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that will receive the created path gradient.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns 'Ok'. If the 'grad' parameter is null, it returns 'InvalidParameter'. If the 'points' parameter is null or 'count' is less than or equal to 0, it returns 'OutOfMemory'.

function.name: GdipCreatePathGradientI
function.description: This function creates a path gradient based on an array of points, count of points, wrap mode, and a pointer to the gradient path. It checks for valid parameters, creates a path, adds a line to the path, creates a path gradient, and sets the wrap mode of the gradient. It returns a status indicating success or failure of these operations.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of points used to create the path

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of points in the array

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: Specifies the wrap mode for the gradient

parameters.name: grad
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the gradient path to be created

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the function execution. It can be 'Ok' for successful execution or 'InvalidParameter' and 'OutOfMemory' for unsuccessful execution

function.name: GdipCreatePathGradientFromPath
function.description: This function creates a path gradient from a given path. It first checks if the parameters are not null, then clones the path and creates a path gradient. If the creation of the path gradient is not successful, it deletes the cloned path.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: This is the path from which the gradient will be created.

parameters.name: grad
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer where the created path gradient will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can be Ok if the operation was successful, InvalidParameter if the grad parameter is null, or OutOfMemory if the path parameter is null.
